policy.last_change: 4 Mar 2026 (-25bp, eff. 5 Mar); held 9 Apr and 6 May

policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 12 May close (1x4 3.92, 3x6 4.10, 6x9 4.42, 9x12 4.66 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 80bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 6 May (core probably rose in April; wait-and-see); Glapiński (7 May): the probability of a hike has risen and a cut is very unlikely - a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action. Zarzecki (12 May): no change through 2026 is the base case, hikes need current and projected CPI above 3.5%; Wnorowski: no need to hike now. April flash CPI 3.2% (30 Apr; 3.0% expected); core 2.7% in March. The fuel VAT and excise cuts run to 15 May.
policy.risk_text: Glapiński (7 May) moved to hike risk: a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action - May CPI (29 May) and the July projection are the tests. The front end trades oil and the Iran talks; long end: heavy May supply.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after March PLN 69.6bn (25.6% of the limit); the fiscal notification and the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; the SAFE loan was signed on 8 May; fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) to 15 May.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~49% (after 28 Apr, MoF) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 184bn at end-April (MoF estimate); 8 May T-bill PLN 3.66bn at 4.151%. S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May), DBRS A with a negative trend; Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May; April CPI 3.2% y/y; 2025 GDP 3.6%, Q4 4.1%. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable (affirmed 8 May). 12 May: MoF offers PLN 6-11bn on 13 May (new 2Y OK0129, PS0130, NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436, NZ0936); BGK offers FPC bonds on 14 May; Zarzecki: base case no change through 2026, but hike odds rose - hikes need current and projected CPI above 3.5%; Wnorowski: no need to hike now, though the risk has risen; the Fiscal Council called the MoF's shock scenario too optimistic; Pekao cut 2026 GDP to 3.5%. Abroad: US April CPI 3.8% (core 2.8%), above forecasts; gilt 10Y 5.11% (18-year high); Bund 10Y 3.10% with three ECB hikes priced (June 86%); Brent ~$108 as Trump called the truce 'incredibly weak'.

calendar.plan_text: MoF May plan (30 Apr): sale auctions on 13 May (PLN 6-12bn), 21 May (7-13bn) and 27 May (6-12bn) in OK0129 (new 2Y, replaces OK0128), NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; a 46-week T-bill on 8 May (3-6bn); no switch. ~49% of 2026 needs financed after the April sales. 8 May T-bill: PLN 3.66bn at 4.151% plus 0.55bn. 13 May offer (12 May): PLN 6-11bn, PS0130 added.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining May sales: 13 May, 21 May, 27 May. Next MPC 1-2 Jun: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker.

facts.core_text: Regime: deal hopes versus stalemate - oil swinging around $100-110; the NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May while FRAs price roughly 80bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the BoE for hikes, the Fed has turned to hike risk, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 50bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 269bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 12 May close). US CPI 3.8%; gilt 10Y 5.11% (12 May).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK offers FPC0229, FPC0231, FPC0332 and FPC0235 on 14 May (min PLN 0.5bn); next tender 28 May; the FWSZ 2026 bond plan is PLN 76.6bn.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
